heading: Other Dev is a catalyst for disruptive ideas through creative innovation. A studio of radical optimists crafting new identities, systems, experiences and genres.
body: Based in Karachi, we are a full-service digital studio that designs and engineers web platforms, Shopify experiences, AI-powered products and custom digital solutions from the ground up, with a focus on bringing ideas to life through thoughtful design.
principlesHeading: We’re guided by principles that we believe in and live by.

principles.title: Create Dangerously
principles.body: Pursue excellence in execution and attention to detail.

principles.title: Champion Openness
principles.body: Work openly with others to create better outcomes.

principles.title: Forever Curious
principles.body: Make meaningful contributions that drive progress.

principles.title: Think New
principles.body: Guide, influence, and bring clarity to the path ahead.

principles.title: Future First
principles.body: Stay open, adaptable, and always ready to learn.

teamHeading: We’re a multi-disciplinary team of curious designers, developers, and strategists.
